name: Edw. P. Drury
role: Deputy sheriff of Morton County, at Mandan
bio: Edw. P. (Ed) Drury of Mandan was deputy sheriff of Morton County and served the law in Medora before Billings County was organized. In 1885 he came with Prosecuting Attorney T. K. Long to collect liquor licenses, served an attachment on the Cantonment property, signed sheriff's notices for Sheriff George W. Harmon, and in February 1886 his arrival with the Stark County sheriff scattered young men who had fired six-shooters at a departing train.
